trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: frequent small redemption transactions forcing ETWAP updates.

direct_effect.reason: Redemption cap bypassed, achieving 71% vs intended 50% exit rate and more tokens redeemed across multiple tx than one.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected ~50%/hour cap vs actual 71% gives numeric expected-vs-actual relation.

summary: Report identifies the ETWAP redemption cap functions, the frequent-small-transaction trigger, the resulting cap bypass with concrete rates, and an explicit intended-vs-actual numeric limit, sufficient to attempt formalization.
